desc.en: A strange Slag with a large number of legs. These strange Slags are even stranger, having the characteristics of all other similar types of Slag. It's possible that they have not been separated into different roles yet.
desc.ja: 多数の足を持つ風変わりなスラグ。他の同種のスラグの特徴をすべて備えているという風変わりの上を行く風変わりなスラグ。役割が別れる前の状態なのかもしれない
